horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Jitoma y Nokaido, la contienda del Sol y el Tucán. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P09 — Monaya Jitoma / Jobiya. Jobiya: sturdy mature man, LONG rectangular face, heavier natural nose, black shoulder hair parted centrally. Broad ochre fibre headband with THREE RED feathers angled backward, narrow brown bark loincover, pale sparse tooth-shape PAPER neck pendants, two original sweeping charcoal cheek arcs and vertical chin line. No nasal pin. A single white upper-arm-paper stripe, scarlet / charcoal identity, no green corona.
Reference 2: V05 — Nokaido: tucán. 
Reference 3: L03 — Río · ribera baja y paso. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide forest-and-low-riverbank in pale morning mist. ONE whole mature Jobiya matching P09 red backward feathers carries a complete blowpipe, while ONE whole natural toucan matching the animal views of V05 flies several body lengths ahead toward the right. The hunter follows below on exposed roots, not floating or shooting yet. River, bends and named territorial memory are expressed as a coherent winding route, never as an invented labeled map. Bright scarlet hunter accents and toucan yellow/black/red contrast with blue-green paper forest. No wife, corpse, gore, other hunters, hybrid toucan-human face or random macaws.

VISIBLE CHECK: Jobiya sigue a un tucán completo por una ribera continua.

Tall forest clearing at late sun, elevated diagonal view between whole tall trunks. MYTH: Jitoma y Nokaido, la contienda del Sol y el Tucán. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: V05 — Nokaido: tucán. 
Reference 2: L03 — Río · ribera baja y paso. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE large whole TOUCAN TAIL FEATHER, black with a quiet yellow-red root accent, lies diagonally on charcoal-green forest paper. Its central shaft becomes a narrow blue winding RIVER, splitting the feather's two barbs into folded bank-like forests. This is an original editorial metaphor for a pursuit preserved as territorial memory, not a certified Huitoto map or naming glyph. Only one feather-river carrier, fully visible; the paper channel continuous from base to tip. No people, bird body, text, labels, compass or separate scenery postcard.

VISIBLE CHECK: Una pluma completa cuya raquis se vuelve cauce.
